description: An ARQ C_PDU goes out as one DATA-ONLY with FSN 0 once the link is made; the peer's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 acknowledges it, the wait for an acknowledgement stops and the C_PDU is confirmed.
note: Link setup as cas/make-caller-accepted: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ, its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call the peer (Ed4 request out at 75000, sent at 80550), and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link with the 16-bit family (B-0219, B-0142): window edges TX LWE 0, TX UWE 65535, RX LWE 0, RX UWE 65535 (C-0782, C-0787). The held U_PDU goes down as an ARQ C_PDU (A-0194) and dts.ttd runs to its TTD (C-1050). The burst ends at 92000 with the EOT prediction at 96000 ahead and data queued: csma.vdcd_end; at 96000 LBT rule 1 (the burst was addressed only to us, K-0067) and contention, 12000 ms (second draw). At 108000 the C_PDU (DATA C_PDU, 10 bytes: the S_PDU with TTD and 'ping') is placed whole in one DATA-ONLY (type 9, C-0172, C-0505): FSN 0, the first from the initial TX UWE 65535 (C-0189, C-0191, C-0766), C_PDU START and END (C-0506), DELIVER IN ORDER as the SIS asked (delivery mode ORDER 0, A-0077), TX WIN UWE and TX WIN LWE both set since FSN 0 is now both edges (C-0185, C-0186, C-1122). 29 bytes, 2 blocks, EOT 20. When the transmission ends at 118350, dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts with dts.ack_wait_ms (C-1120). At 126000 the peer's ACK-ONLY (type 10) carries RX LWE 1 and no bitmap: FSN 0 is acknowledged and TX LWE moves to 1 (C-0780, C-0781), nothing awaits an acknowledgement, so dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed to the CAS (C-0679, C-1130; the SIS has nothing to send for it until P6-1), and with no TTD left in the queue dts.ttd is cancelled. The burst ends at 127000 with nothing queued. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Transmissions are zero filled: fill is P4-3's.
